written: 2026-10-10, before any v2 run was launched. Scope: post-hoc supplementary runs asked for by the skeptic review. They do NOT alter the original criterion in prereg.json, which is applied unchanged (final state; |H_fit/H-1|<=0.10 AND rms<=0.05 AND KE<1e-4 of peak) to every run.
driver: u11_sph_v2.py = final u11_sph.py + one argument --cfl (default 0.3, dt = cfl*h/max(c_s, v_max)); unmodified engine

R1_reruns_C1_to_C8.what: C1..C8 re-run with u11_sph_v2.py at the default --cfl 0.3, same arguments as queue_line.txt
R1_reruns_C1_to_C8.prediction: bitwise identical to the v1 run JSONs on every stored leaf (fit, y, rho, nnb, vy, history fits); adds ke_parcels and ke_free_over_peak where v1 lacked them

R2_independent_seeds.what: C2 configuration (line, N 128, h/H 0.2, 2000-step budget, max 8000 steps) with seeds 4, 5, 7, 11
R2_independent_seeds.prediction: each final H_fit/H in [0.995, 1.010] and rms <= 0.005 (H and rms legs PASS); KE leg FAIL with KE/peak between 1e-3 and 3e-3 (floor limit cycle)
R2_independent_seeds.pass: all four seeds inside the stated H and rms ranges

R3_dt_scaling_of_floor_KE.what: C2 configuration, seed 3, --cfl 0.15 (dt x0.5, max 16000 steps) and --cfl 0.075 (dt x0.25, max 20000 steps); same stop rule as prereg.json (stop at the first settled step after the 2000-step budget, else at max_steps)
R3_dt_scaling_of_floor_KE.model: restitution limit cycle of the merged floor clump: each step the floor returns the column weight N m g dt, so the clump leaves the floor at v_out = e N g dt / ((1+e) N_f), e = 0.5 (GroundPlane default 0.50, ContinuumParcel restitution 0.5); floor KE = 0.5 N_f m v_out^2, i.e. proportional to dt^2 / N_f

predictions.a: if a floor clump exists at the end, its common vy equals the model value with the measured N_f to within 5 %
predictions.b: floor-clump KE/peak = 1.578e-3 * f^2 * (33/N_f), f = dt factor (C2 baseline: 1.578e-3 at N_f = 33)
predictions.c: H_fit/H within 0.10 of 1 (expected within 0.01): the time step does not change the hydrostatic profile
predictions.d: pre-registered KE leg: f = 0.5 FAIL (predicted 3.9e-4 at N_f = 33); f = 0.25 marginal (predicted 9.9e-5 at N_f = 33) - no confident call, it hinges on N_f and on the free atmosphere having settled within 20000 steps (t = 300 H/c_s)

R3_dt_scaling_of_floor_KE.pass: a and c hold for both runs; b within 25 % (N_f and peak KE may shift with dt)

evidential_weight: engine and diagnosis validation only; no bearing on the unification thesis
